title: On-Adapter-TU: trained adapter (round-3 a0e15) with small-step online updates, optionally behind the backbone-first gate
frozen_at: 2026-10-09, after the round-5 seed-2 test (S = 1.003279, not first) and before any round-6 trajectory
exploratory_disclosure: Exploratory iteration on an already observed test period; motivated by repeated validation-to-test reversals that a fixed offline adapter cannot absorb.

hypothesis.problem: The trained adapter's sign of benefit changes between the validation and test periods; the original rate 3e-4 adapts but drifts and blows up.
hypothesis.change: Online parameter updates of the trained a0e15 adapter (all adapter parameters, original Adam update, original maturity rule) at small rates; optionally the round-5 backbone-first abstaining gate (gs 0.9, mu 0) on top.
hypothesis.falsified_if: validation selects lr 0 without change, or the selected candidate's seed-2 test S is not below every baseline

randomness: entry seed 200 (stream r=0) for every candidate; lr 0 reuses the round-3 a0e15 trajectories (identical rule: no parameter step)
selection: seed-2 validation; robust score = max(whole-stream GM over 36 tasks of the CVaR90 ratio to iTransformer, largest per-third GM); argmin; ties toward smaller lr, then no gate
formal_test: selected candidate run once on the 36 seed-2 test streams (r=0) and scored with frozen cell_metrics against the fixed seed-2 baselines
budget: 3 rates x 36 validation trajectories on CPU, then 36 test trajectories for the selected rate
